name: Angel Wings
source:
Angel Wings is a Kdrama-inspired visual novel exploring themes of isolation, dependence, and autonomy set in an unfamiliar new city.

As the player, you begin your journey from rock bottom -- no job, no friends and no motivation — but upon answering a mysterious phone call, you awaken in an unknown place filled with new faces. Through intricate relationships and thoughtful introspection, you will experience love, catharsis, or heartbreak.

Will you soar to new heights, or fly too close to the sun?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/862440/Angel_Wings/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《天使之翼》是一部受韩剧启发的视觉小说，以陌生的新城市为背景，探索孤立、依赖和自主的主题。

作为玩家，你从最低谷开始你的旅程——没有工作，没有朋友，没有动力——但在接听一个神秘电话后，你在一个充满新面孔的未知地方醒来。通过错综复杂的关系和深思熟虑的内省，你会体验到爱、宣泄或心碎。

你会翱翔到新的高度，还是飞得离太阳太近？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/862440/Angel_Wings/]Steam[/url]]
